title: Replace WellSpent app icons with adaptive hourglass artwork
outcome: Replace the existing clock-check icon with a recognizable hourglass in iPhone light and dark appearances and the matching Watch identity.

included: Replace the iPhone app icon with opaque 1024-pixel light and dark hourglass assets using native asset-catalog appearances.
Replace the Watch app icon with the matching light hourglass identity, preserving circle-safe composition.
Document generated-art provenance, prompts, appearance behavior and validation boundaries.
excluded: Timer behavior, persistence, wire contracts, signing configuration, bundle identifiers and version allocation.
Public support/privacy changes, App Store upload, submission and release.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Native asset catalogs reference distinct recognizable light and dark hourglass artwork for iOS and a matching circle-safe Watch icon; all source images are 1024x1024 RGB PNGs.
Independent review confirms coherent geometry, legibility at app-icon sizes, unchanged app behavior, and complete source/provenance documentation.
